writeup: Woot has the brand-new 2027 DeMarini The Goods (-8) USSSA bat in 32 inch / 24 oz (model WBD2712010) for $79.99. That is about $220 less than Closeout Bats at $299.95 and BaseballMonkey at $299.99. It has a two-piece hybrid build with a 2 3/4 inch X14 alloy barrel, and Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
